royal.songTitle: Pagan Angel and a Borrowed Car
royal.linePrev: When they caught the king beneath the borrowed car
royal.line: Righteous, drunk, and fumbling for the royal keys
royal.lineNext: Love was a father's flag and sung like a shank
stanza: Love was a promise made of smoke
In a frozen copse of trees
A bone cold and older than our bodies
Slowly floating in the sea
Every morning there were planes
The shiny blades of pagan angels in our father's skies
Every evening I would watch her hold the pillow

I was still a beggar shaking out my stolen coat
